'''Klubi i Futbollit Bylis''' is an Albanian professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Ballsh]], part of [[Mallakastër]] municipality. They compete in [[Kategoria e Parë]], the second tier of [[Football in Albania|Albanian football]]. Their home ground is [[Adush Muça Stadium]]."}}
